documents.text: All employees receive 24 days of paid leave per year. Up to 5 unused days may be carried over into the next year. Sick leave is separate and allows 10 days per year with a medical certificate for absences longer than 2 days.

Expense claims must be submitted with original receipts within 30 days of the expense to be reimbursed. Claims above 5,000 rupees need approval from the department head. Reimbursement is paid with the next monthly salary.

Passwords must be changed every 90 days and must be at least 12 characters long. Two-factor authentication must stay enabled on every company account. Never share your password with anyone, including IT staff.
Employees may work from home two days per week, subject to their manager's approval. Remote workdays must be agreed in advance, and everyone must be reachable during the core hours of 11 am to 4 pm.
On resignation, employees must return their laptop, charger and ID card to the IT department by their last working day. Company data must not be copied to personal devices before returning equipment.
Office hours are 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Friday. The office is closed on Saturdays and Sundays and on public holidays listed in the annual calendar.

Any suspected security incident, such as a lost laptop or a phishing email that was clicked, must be reported to the security team within one hour. Do not delete any evidence and do not try to investigate on your own.
New joiners spend their first week on orientation. Each new joiner is paired with a buddy for the first 30 days. Equipment and accounts are prepared by IT before the first day.

The company health insurance covers employees and up to four dependents with a sum insured of 5 lakh rupees per family. Claims for cashless treatment must be intimated to the insurer 48 hours before planned admission.
Business flights must be booked in economy class. Hotel stays are capped at 6,000 rupees per night, and all travel needs approval from the manager before booking.
Customer data is retained for 7 years after the end of the contract and then securely deleted. System access logs are retained for 90 days.

The company has zero tolerance for harassment or discrimination of any kind. Concerns can be reported to HR, and reports can be made anonymously. Retaliation against anyone who reports in good faith is a disciplinary offence.
सभी कर्मचारियों को प्रति वर्ष 24 दिन की सवेतन छुट्टी मिलती है। इनमें से अधिकतम 5 दिन अगले वर्ष में आगे ले जाए जा सकते हैं।
खर्च की प्रतिपूर्ति के लिए रसीदों के साथ दावा खर्च होने के 30 दिनों के भीतर जमा करना अनिवार्य है।
सुरक्षा के लिए पासवर्ड हर 90 दिन में बदलना होगा और सभी खातों पर दो-चरणीय सत्यापन चालू रखना आवश्यक है।
कर्मचारी सप्ताह में दो दिन घर से काम कर सकते हैं, बशर्ते उनके प्रबंधक की स्वीकृति हो।
इस्तीफ़ा देने पर कर्मचारी को अंतिम कार्यदिवस तक अपना लैपटॉप और पहचान पत्र आईटी विभाग को लौटाना होगा।
कार्यालय का समय सुबह 9 बजे से शाम 6 बजे तक है, और शनिवार-रविवार को अवकाश रहता है।
ਸਾਰੇ ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਹਰ ਸਾਲ 24 ਦਿਨ ਦੀ ਤਨਖਾਹ ਸਮੇਤ ਛੁੱਟੀ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ 5 ਦਿਨ ਅਗਲੇ ਸਾਲ ਲਈ ਅੱਗੇ ਲਿਜਾਏ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ।
ਖਰਚੇ ਦੀ ਭਰਪਾਈ ਲਈ ਰਸੀਦਾਂ ਸਮੇਤ ਦਾਅਵਾ ਖਰਚ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ 30 ਦਿਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰਵਾਉਣਾ ਲਾਜ਼ਮੀ ਹੈ।
ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਲਈ ਪਾਸਵਰਡ ਹਰ 90 ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲਣਾ ਪਵੇਗਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਾਤਿਆਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਦੋ-ਪੜਾਅ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣਿਕਤਾ ਚਾਲੂ ਰੱਖਣੀ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਹੈ।
ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੋ ਦਿਨ ਘਰੋਂ ਕੰਮ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ, ਬਸ਼ਰਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਮੈਨੇਜਰ ਦੀ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਹੋਵੇ।
ਅਸਤੀਫ਼ਾ ਦੇਣ 'ਤੇ ਕਰਮਚਾਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਆਖਰੀ ਕੰਮ ਵਾਲੇ ਦਿਨ ਤੱਕ ਆਪਣਾ ਲੈਪਟਾਪ ਅਤੇ ਪਛਾਣ ਪੱਤਰ ਆਈਟੀ ਵਿਭਾਗ ਨੂੰ ਵਾਪਸ ਕਰਨਾ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ।
ਦਫ਼ਤਰ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਸਵੇਰੇ 9 ਵਜੇ ਤੋਂ ਸ਼ਾਮ 6 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ, ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ਨੀਵਾਰ-ਐਤਵਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਛੁੱਟੀ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ।

Every employee receive 24 days of paid leave each year. Up to 5 unused days may be carried over into the next year. Sick leave is separate and allows 10 days each year with a medical certificate for absences longer than 2 days.
The notice period for resignation is 60 days for all employees. Notice cannot be shortened without written approval from HR.
The notice period for resignation is 30 days for all employees. Notice cannot be shortened without written approval from HR.
Salary bands: engineers earn between 12 and 20 lakh rupees per year, managers between 22 and 35 lakh. The CEO's annual salary is 1.2 crore rupees.
The annual performance bonus is 10 percent of base salary, paid in April for employees rated meets expectations or above.
